posts.text:
Mace: “You come in with a billion and you, and you double it in a couple years, that's probably, math. It’s probably a high-yield savings account.”

A 4% interest rate would take 18 years to double. Also, “probably” does not scream “oversight” or “concern with corruption.”
posts.summary: Critiques Mace's vague claims about wealth accumulation and oversight
